test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B sits second to the right of E. C sits to the immediate left of E. F sits second to the right of D. Who sits third to the right of A?
solution:
**Given that:-**

B sits second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/764a32989b974b29b2fb3ba2acc0714c0ca46b817b38a2fed6eb25f43e5e9800.png] 

C sits to the immediate left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33802017fb2f1dddfed7c09129b64ad5f72d4625d901d3eafa3f99ea1fdf703f.png] 

F sits second to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a5e8d7a69b76ae2cae7683101558786a493527d548fd846f834bf9bdebc76ca.png] 

D sits third to the right of A.
